blocks.section: Door Switch Circuit
blocks.content: Door Switch Circuit

blocks.section: Door Switch Circuit
blocks.content: Perform the following checks if the dishwasher does not detect the door open or closed. This test will check the wiring to the door switch and the door switch itself. The following items are part of the door switch circuit.

blocks.section: Door Switch Circuit
blocks.content:   Harness/Connection

blocks.section: Door Switch Circuit
blocks.content:   Door Switch/Latch Assembly

blocks.section: Door Switch Circuit
blocks.content:   Control Board

blocks.section: Test Procedure
blocks.content: Test Procedure

blocks.section: Test Procedure
blocks.content: Check for improper installation of the dishwasher or leveling. Check door latch mechanism for obstructions or binding. Verify door seal is seated properly. Check for interference between dish racks and door. Repair as necessary.

blocks.section: Test Procedure
blocks.content: Unplug dishwasher or disconnect power.

blocks.section: Test Procedure
blocks.content: Remove the access panel and the control board cover. Remove or fold back plastic cover over door switch.

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.caption: Door Switch Strip Circuit

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: Figure 1 - Door Switch Strip Circuit

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: Check door switch contacts and all connections in the door switch circuit. Visually check that the CN6 connector on the control and the door latch terminals are securely installed.

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: ¾ ¾ If visual check passes, go to step 5.

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: ¾ ¾ If any of the connectors are not inserted properly, reconnect and retest door latch/switch.

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: Disconnect connector CN6 from the control board.

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: Using an ohmmeter, measure across CN6, pins 1 and 3 (12V & IS respectively) with the door closed, strike completely in latch mechanism (switch closed).

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: ¾ ¾ If 3 ohms or less is measured, proceed to step 7.

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: ¾ ¾ If high resistance is measured when door is closed, check for loose connections and repair as needed.

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: Using an ohmmeter, measure across CN6, pins 1 and 3 (12V & IS respectively) with the door open, strike removed from latch mechanism (switch open).

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: ¾ ¾ If reading is infinite, go to step 8.

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: ¾ ¾ If reading shows continuity, or door switch is damaged, replace door switch and retest.

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: Set voltmeter to DC and connect red lead to CN6, pin 1 (12V) and black lead to CN4, pin 2 (DC GND) on the control board.

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: Plug in dishwasher or reconnect power and with door open, verify that 12 VDC is present across CN6-1 and CN42.

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: ¾ ¾ If 12 VDC is not present, replace the control and retest.

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: ¾ ¾ If 12 VDC is present, proceed to step 10.

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: Reconnect CN6 & CN4 to control board and perform Diagnostic Cycle to verify operation.

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: Unplug dishwasher or disconnect power.

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: Reassemble all parts and panels.

blocks.section: STRIP CIRCUIT - DOOR SWITCH DOOR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
blocks.content: Plug in dishwasher or reconnect power.
